purpose: Repair ranking-serving candidate-distribution mismatch exposed by the rejected ItemCF-plus-DeepFM evaluation.
hypothesis: Adding Train-only I2I candidates that compete with each positive target as labeled hard negatives teaches DeepFM to distinguish retrieval-plausible alternatives, allowing complementary ItemCF candidates to be safely reranked.
single_core_variable: negative_sampling=candidate_aware: for each Train positive, append a fixed number of non-interacted ItemCF candidates from a Train-only index; architecture, seed, optimizer, selection-only split and existing exposure/random negatives are unchanged.
acceptance_rule: Before deployment, evaluate the same frozen end-to-end candidate-pool protocol. Require Recall@10 +0.003, NDCG@10 +0.002, and Tail PQ0 non-inferior within -0.002 versus fixed-ranker baseline. No post-result sampling or threshold changes.
closure: This is ranking hypothesis family candidate 1 of at most 2. If it fails for the same end-to-end gates, preserve the result and diagnose before any second candidate.
